editorialNote: Original Chinese summaries checked against the named references. Source-based editorial review is not an independent expert evaluation of the recordings.

cambridge-english.title: Cambridge · 英语语音
cambridge-english.publisher: Cambridge University Press, The English Language
cambridge-english.supports: English fricatives, stops, sonorants and RP vowel/diphthong articulation.

oxford-notation.title: Oxford · 英式词典注音
oxford-notation.supports: British broad notation, non-rhotic r, schwa/stress, variants, traditional centring diphthongs and example words.

bc-voicing.title: British Council · 清浊
bc-voicing.supports: Voicing as vocal-fold vibration, consonant contrasts.

bc-schwa.title: British Council · 轻读元音
bc-schwa.supports: Schwa in unstressed syllables, banana example.

ps-vowels.title: Pronunciation Studio · 元音口形
ps-vowels.supports: Jaw, tongue and lip dimensions; vowel-quality differences rather than duration alone.

ps-monophthongs.title: Pronunciation Studio · 单元音
ps-monophthongs.supports: British vowel positions and rounding; modern /uː/ fronting. Uses modern symbols differing from our dictionary convention.

ps-diphthongs.title: Pronunciation Studio · 双元音与变体
ps-diphthongs.supports: Same-syllable movement and contemporary centring-diphthong changes; /ʊə/ variation.

roach-articulators.title: Cambridge · Roach 发音器官与英式元音
roach-articulators.publisher: Cambridge University Press, Peter Roach, English Phonetics and Phonology, 4th edition
roach-articulators.supports: §§2.1–2.3, pp. 8–14: articulator anatomy, velum, lips, tongue height/frontness, English short vowels. Original figures consulted, not reproduced.

seeing-speech.title: Glasgow · Seeing Speech 发音影像
seeing-speech.publisher: University of Glasgow; Lawson, Stuart-Smith, Scobbie and Nakai (2018)
seeing-speech.supports: IPA place/manner and live articulator visualization using MRI, ultrasound and animation. Generic IPA demonstrations, not a one-to-one British dictionary model. English /r/ maps to approximant [ɹ]. Links only; no video/image copied.

phonetics-overview.title: Cambridge · 辅音部位、塞擦音与边音
phonetics-overview.publisher: Cambridge University Press, Phonetics Overview (Introducing Phonology companion)
phonetics-overview.supports: §2 consonant place/manner, affricates and lateral airflow. General articulation only: its American vowel examples are not the British vowel model.
